description: SimRa provides crowdsourced cycling trips, incident observations and regional result maps from the SimRa cycling-safety project. The provider is Technische Universität Berlin and Einstein Center Digital Future. Geographical and temporal coverage: The site reports results by participating region. Incident downloads are an older snapshot; no universal observation period or resolution is asserted. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page says automatic analysis stopped in April 2025; some maps were manually regenerated in autumn 2025 while a replacement platform was planned. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
